features.title: Actionable Recommendations
features.description: Generate actionable recommendations for optimizing pipeline performance and costs.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are based on analyzed data trends.
Each recommendation includes a potential impact assessment.
Users receive notifications when new recommendations are available.

features.title: Interactive Visualizations
features.description: Create interactive visualizations to help identify bottlenecks in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations highlight potential bottlenecks in the pipeline.
Users can filter data by time range and pipeline stage.
Visualizations are responsive and update with user interactions.

features.title: Interactive Jupyter Notebook
features.description: Develop an interactive Jupyter notebook for visualizing pipeline performance trends and stage-by-stage breakdowns.
acceptance_criteria: Users can access the Jupyter notebook through a web interface.
The notebook displays pipeline performance trends over time.
Users can interact with the visualizations to explore data.

features.title: Detailed Statistical Summaries
features.description: Provide detailed statistical summaries of pipeline execution metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Statistical summaries include mean, median, and standard deviation.
Summaries are available for each stage of the pipeline.
Data is updated in real-time as new metrics are collected.
